BrochureContent.Content:
Exceptional Architect-Designed Residence in Castlegregory.
Occupying a superb setting within an exclusive cluster of quality homes and surrounded by the breath taking scenery of the Dingle Peninsula, this outstanding architect-designed detached residence offers an exceptional blend of contemporary design, luxury living and natural beauty.
From the moment you enter, this home impresses with its unique architectural features and sense of space. At its heart lies a spectacular internal atrium, enclosed by striking cut-stone walls and centred around a light filled space from the ceiling, creating a tranquil focal point that seamlessly connects the indoors with nature. This stunning feature fills the home with natural light and provides a truly unique living environment.
The accommodation has been thoughtfully designed to maximise both comfort and flow. The magnificent living room is a standout feature, boasting a dramatic high ceiling and an abundance of natural light from large sliding doors that open directly onto the gardens and outdoor entertaining areas. A contemporary double-sided stove creates a warm and inviting atmosphere while providing a stylish connection to the impressive open-plan kitchen and dining area.
The kitchen is perfectly designed for modern family living and entertaining, featuring quality fitted cabinetry, generous island unit and distinctive varying ceiling heights that add character and architectural interest. Double doors open directly onto the garden, creating an effortless transition between indoor and outdoor living spaces.
The bedroom accommodation is equally impressive, with all bedrooms enjoying direct access to the surrounding decking or landscaped gardens through sliding patio doors. The spacious master suite benefits from its own en-suite bathroom and garden access, offering a private retreat within the home.
The main family bathroom has been beautifully appointed and features a luxurious freestanding bath together with his-and-her wash hand basins, creating a spa-like atmosphere for relaxation and comfort.
Outside, the property is surrounded by mature landscaped gardens, extensive decking areas and private outdoor patio spaces designed for year-round enjoyment. A detached garden shed and outdoor hot tub provide the perfect setting to unwind while taking in the peaceful surroundings. The generous gravelled driveway offers ample parking and enhances the property's attractive kerb appeal.
Castlegregory is one of Ireland's most desirable coastal destinations, renowned for its magnificent beaches, world-class water sports, scenic mountain walks and vibrant hospitality scene. Whether surfing at nearby beaches, exploring the Maharees, enjoying local restaurants and traditional pubs, or venturing along the spectacular route to Dingle, this location offers an enviable lifestyle in one of the country's most beautiful settings.
Combining exceptional architecture, luxurious accommodation and a prime location, this remarkable residence presents a rare opportunity to acquire a truly distinctive home in the heart of West Kerry.
Viewing are by prior appointment with this office and joint agents Daire McCann Property.
